headword: {東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}する
reading: とうほんせいそうする
gloss: to rush about; to run around busily

definitions.gloss: to rush about; to run around busily; to be constantly on the go
definitions.explanation: To hurry from place to place in order to accomplish something, especially making efforts to arrange or resolve matters.

examples.japanese: {資金集|しきんあつ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}する。
⟦{選挙|せんきょ}{運動|うんどう}→選挙運動：26087_senkyoundou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}した。
examples.english: I ran around busily for the election campaign.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The sales manager is constantly rushing around every day to acquire new clients.

notes:
A four-character idiom (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧): ⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧ (east) + {奔|ほん} (run) + ⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧ (west) + {走|そう} (run). Literally "running east and dashing west," conveying the image of someone hurrying in all directions. Used in formal and literary contexts to describe someone making great efforts, often with a positive connotation of dedication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}→東奔西走：18722_touhonseisou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧ — days of rushing about
- {資金集|しきんあつ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}する — rush about raising funds
- ⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}する — run around trying to resolve something

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{奔走|ほんそう}する→奔走する：25550_honsousuru⟧ — to run about; to make efforts — simpler two-character version, very similar meaning
- ⟦{駆|か}け{回|まわ}る→駆け回る：06113_kakemawaru⟧ — to run around — more colloquial, physical action
- ⟦{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る→飛び回る：04610_tobimawaru⟧ — to fly around — emphasizes rapid movement from place to place
